## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasToolbar> CreateStandardToolbar( const std::string& identifier = "Toolbar" );   // Standard horizontal toolbar
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasToolbar> CreateDockStyleToolbar( const std::string& identifier = "Dock" );   // macOS-style dock
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasToolbar> CreateRibbonToolbar( const std::string& identifier = "Ribbon" );   // Ribbon-style toolbar with multiple rows
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasToolbar> CreateSidebarToolbar( const std::string& identifier = "Sidebar" );   // Vertical sidebar
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasToolbar> CreateStatusBar( const std::string& identifier = "StatusBar" );   // Status bar
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasToolbar(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
UltraCanvasToolbar(const std::string& identifier, float width, float height);
explicit UltraCanvasToolbar(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `OverflowNone = 0` | No overflow handling |
